mechanism: Fluconazole inhibits CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing eslicarbazepine exposure, while eslicarbazepine is an inducer of multiple CYP450 enzymes that may increase fluconazole metabolism.
action: Monitor for eslicarbazepine toxicity (dizziness, ataxia, diplopia) and fluconazole efficacy; consider alternative antifungal if feasible or adjust eslicarbazepine dosing based on clinical response.
